children: Shoulder Innovations said the Food and Drug Administration had granted 510(k) clearance for the company's N-22 Humeral Head, a titanium implant option for patients with metal hypersensitivity.
The humeral head is a ball shaped portion of the arm bone that connects with the shoulder blade in the shoulder joint.

Shoulder Innovations said it was also commercially launching the product, which is designed for use in anatomic total shoulder arthroplasty procedures. It complements Shoulder Innovation's N-22 Glenosphere implant, which is used in reverse total shoulder arthroplasty procedures among the same patient population, the company added.
A 510(K) submission is made before a device is brought to market to demonstrate it can be marketed as safe and effective, the FDA said.
